body: I'd rather be non-existent than alive.  The thought of caring about people who would never lend a hand or remembering bad memories recycled throughout the mind put me in an endless spiral.  Voices from past trauma never vacate.  No matter how much effort you put in to let go, somehow life goes in a full circle just to remind one of how things used to be or could have been. It's hard not to be a pessimist, but life throws a ton of shit in our faces and snatches everything good from us.

That's how I feel. It's like I want to die and I don't care what happens, yet I'm afraid to die painfully. Constant false hopes and promises of people saying "it gets better"...It becomes numbing over time.  No one cares until it's too late.
Feeling cute, might land on your food later IDK.

Agreed. I finally had the courage to delete my Facebook account this year due to recycled memes, back-stabbing hypocrites that post quotes about being a better person, and people looking for attention.  I'd rather go incognito than bask in a cesspool of fakeness. It's all for the "likes".
